questions.q: n = 4,096 tokens, window 8. Roughly what share of full attention's pairs are left?
questions.why: n × 64 ÷ n² = 64 ÷ 4,096, the 0.0156 in the table.

questions.q: Why do fixed windows need a helper such as shifting?
options: Information can't cross a window border without it
questions.answer: Information can't cross a window border without it
questions.why: The reach table: stuck at 64 forever.

questions.q: Masked full attention gives the same output as separate windows. So what do separate windows add?
questions.why: The lab's mask and parts agree, at 256 pairs against 64.

questions.q: A sparse 3D model is still running out of memory. Why could that be?
options: Occupied tokens still cost tokens squared
The grid is stored in a text encoder
questions.answer: Occupied tokens still cost tokens squared
questions.why: Sparsity removes empty cells, and the occupied ones still pair up with each other.

questions.q: A grid isn't a multiple of the window. What should a partition do?
options: Pad, then remove the padding after
questions.answer: Pad, then remove the padding after
questions.why: window_partition pads, and window_unpartition removes it.
